mapper.select: SELECT NAME FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: CONN_ID AS connId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, ORGANIZATION AS organization, CONNECTED_ID_ENC AS connectedIdEnc, KEY_VER AS keyVer, VERIFIED_YN AS verifiedYn, VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_ENC AS verifiedAccountEnc, VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_LAST4 AS verifiedAccountLast4, VERIFIED_HOLDER_NAME AS verifiedHolderName, VERIFIED_AT AS verifiedAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CODEF_CONNECTION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CODEF_CONNECTION T USING ( SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{organization} AS ORGANIZATION FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID AND T.ORGANIZATION = S.ORGANIZATION) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CONNECTED_ID_ENC = #{connectedIdEnc}, T.KEY_VER = #{keyVer}, T.VERIFIED_YN = 'N', T.VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_ENC = NULL, T.VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_LAST4 = NULL, T.VERIFIED_HOLDER_NAME = NULL, T.VERIFIED_AT = NULL, T.UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MEMBER_ID, ORGANIZATION, CONNECTED_ID_ENC, KEY_VER, VERIFIED_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{organization}, #{connectedIdEnc}, #{keyVer}, 'N', #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
